context: a letter from W. R. Grove, which you are answering
exchanges:
Here on circuit I expect to be in London on Monday afternoon— Will you come to breakfast on Tuesday at 9 or 9¼ if you like it later. Tell Mrs Grove if you come

Yrs very sincerely | W R Grove

I am very much obliged for your note. I will call on Tuesday mg. about 9.15 but will not accept your kind invitation to Breakfast. I will wait till you have finished breakfast or join you during your meal as I often do at the Lyells.

yours very sincerely | Ch. Darwin
